Promoter's notes

The fundamentals
  • Every men’s one-on-one match involving the champion is automatically for the title.
  • A title change creates major buzz, but repeatedly swapping the belt damages its prestige.
  • Connected promos and active rivalries strengthen a show; ignored relationships cool down.
  • Promos shift development toward Mic; matches shift it toward Ring.
  • Wrestlers are paid only when booked. Missing the show—and the paycheck—hurts morale.
  • Morale at zero means the wrestler quits and enters the talent market.
